result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one major layout/content overlap issue and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows overlapping text: '25-35 min delivery' text is rendered over itself or clipped, making it appear as '25-3̶0̶delivery' with characters merging/overlapping, making the delivery time unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time and additional metadata text are placed in separate, non-overlapping text elements with proper spacing and layout constraints.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name truncated without an ellipsis or proper truncation handling, cutting off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis or adjust the card width to properly truncate the restaurant name, ensuring users understand the text is cut off.
